form:FormGroup.label: Document
form:FormGroup.helpText: Which Shapeshifter AI document's attempts. Left empty, every document you may read.

form:FormGroup.label: Feed
form:FormGroup.helpText: The feed the stream came from, matched exactly. Left empty, every feed.

form:FormGroup.label: Promotion mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether what the attempt learned was bound automatically or held as a draft for review.

form:FormGroup.label: Status
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where the attempt stands. None ticked — or all of them — is every status.
A deleted pipeline's attempts are kept to be read until they age out. Left unticked, they are not shown.
